MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #10
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 40
   C. 400
   D. 10

2. Solve for x: x + 8 = 12. (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 8
   C. 5
   D. 4

3. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 4
   C. 400
   D. 10

4. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 18
   C. 36
   D. 81

5. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 122
   C. 11
   D. 121

6. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 3
   C. 15
   D. 21

11. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 32

   D. 4

12. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 48

   D. 49

13. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 170
   C. 26
   D. 169

14. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 36
   C. 5
   D. 37

15. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 14
   C. 7
   D. 49

16. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 144
   C. 48
   D. 24

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
